Date: 2026-05-10

Dear Breast urgent suspected cancer team,

Re: Synthetic Given 064 Synthetic Family 064, DOB 1959-05-11, NHS SYN-NHS-000064

I am writing to refer this patient urgently. She presents with a four-week history of a new lump in her right axilla. On examination there is a firm, non-tender axillary lump approximately 2.5 centimetres in size. I examined both breasts carefully and found no discrete breast lump. There are no skin changes on either breast, no nipple discharge, and no skin tethering.

I am aware that the absence of a primary breast lump does not exclude axillary nodal disease as the first presentation of breast malignancy. I am therefore referring under the two-week wait pathway as per NICE NG12 for an unexplained axillary lump.
